_meta.what_this_is: A family of 20 p-values from 20 hypothesis tests where the truth is that NOTHING is real -- every effect tested is null. Under the null, a p-value is uniform on [0,1], so this family is spread roughly evenly across the range, with the smallest two dipping below 0.05 purely by chance. The point: run enough tests and some cross any fixed significance threshold even when there is nothing to find, so a 'significant' result picked from many tests is not evidence until you correct for how many you ran.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. 20 p-values hand-authored to look like a null family (approximately uniform), with two below 0.05 by chance. No random seed needed; the numbers ARE the experiment.
